caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high, narrow back composed of five vertical slats and an ornate top rail featuring a cut-out heart shape in the center. The chair has turned finials at the top of each back post and turned elements along the back and legs. The seat is woven from a lighter material that contrasts subtly with the medium brown color of the wood. The front and side stretchers of the legs are also turned, with the front stretcher being more prominently decorative. The chair is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects present.
title: Heart and Crown Chair
